answer: An economy of decentralized AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by requiring economic stake coupled with cryptographic computation, functioning similarly to a structured trellis of validation nodes where each verified agent must expend proof-of-work resources and stake a non-refundable cryptographic marble to broadcast a valid governance signal.
